title: EtaleLimitAcyclicReplacement
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set and let $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ be an inverse diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms. Let $(X,(f_i))$ be a limit cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $i$, let $F_i$ be an abelian sheaf on $(D_i)_{\acute{e}t}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with maps $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ for $f:i\to j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\acute{e}t})$ be identified objectwise with $f_i^{-1}F_i$ by isomorphisms, its arrows being inverse-image composition followed by pullback of $\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be a colimit cocone on $G$, with coprojections $\iota_i$. Fix n>=0. There exist a compatible coefficient system R_i with identity and composition laws for inverse image, an inverse-image diagram GR with specified isomorphisms GR_i ≅ f_i^{-1}R_i and its canonical transition equations, and a colimit cocone LR. There exist an abelian sheaf E on X_et and a short exact sequence 0 -> L.pt -> E -> LR.pt -> 0. If eta is its extension class, there is an additive homomorphism d:H^n(X,LR.pt)->H^(n+1)(X,L.pt) with d(x)=x composed with eta, and H^(n+1)(X,E) is zero (expressed as Subsingleton). There are additive homomorphisms beta_i:H^n(D_i,R_i)->H^(n+1)(D_i,F_i) such that beta_i followed by the canonical comparison to H^(n+1)(X,L.pt) equals the canonical comparison from H^n(D_i,R_i) to H^n(X,LR.pt) followed by d. Here each canonical comparison is f_i^* followed by the cohomology map of the relevant colimit leg using the specified inverse-image diagram isomorphism. No cohomology diagrams, comparison cocones, or surjectivity conclusion are part of this assertion. Short exact means the first arrow is monic, the second epic, and the first image equals the second kernel; the extension class is the canonical Yoneda Ext^1 class of this sequence.

proof.text: Choose injective embeddings F_k -> A_k. Define E_i as the product of direct images of A_k over arrows i -> k. Adjunction transposes the maps F_i -> E_i and gives their compatibility. The identity component proves they are monomorphisms. Exact inverse image implies direct image preserves injectives; products of injectives are injective. Take the stage cokernels R_i and cancel their epimorphisms to prove the unit and cocycle laws.
Pull these systems to the limit and take filtered sheaf colimits. Exactness gives 0 -> L -> LE -> LR -> 0 with its canonical coprojection maps.

Use the qcqs etale basis on the limit. Descend each finite affine covering and its object to a stage using the affine-site colimit presentation. On a cofinal tail all its iterated covering fibre products are qcqs systems. Apply the full degree-zero section comparison from 09YN (including its equality criterion) on each, with the same prescribed units; finite products give the Cech-complex colimit. The stage injective Cech complexes are positively acyclic, exact filtered group colimits preserve this, and cofinal finite qcqs coverings permit the Cech criterion. Thus LE has zero positive object cohomology at every qcqs object, including the terminal object. This step uses no higher-degree continuity.

Define d as postcomposition with the extension class of the limit short exact sequence. Define beta_i as the stage connecting map. Exact inverse image takes the stage short exact sequence to one on X. The coefficient maps from this pulled-back sequence to the limit sequence form a morphism of short complexes. Naturality of extension classes for that morphism and compatibility of cohomology pullback with extension-class composition identify beta_i followed by the original comparison with the cokernel comparison followed by d. This is the displayed hbeta equation before any comparison-group isomorphisms are introduced.

theorem etale_limit_acyclic_replacement
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (FR : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φR : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (FR i) ⟶ FR j)
    (hidentityR : ∀ i : I, φR (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (FR i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (FR i))
    (hcompositionR : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φR (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (FR i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φR f) ≫ φR g)
    (GR : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eGR : ∀ i : I, GR.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (FR i))
    (hGR : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), GR.map f =
      (eGR i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (FR i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φR f) ≫ (eGR j).inv)
    (LR : Cocone GR) (hLR : IsColimit LR)
    (E : Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (a : L.pt ⟶ E) (b : E ⟶ LR.pt) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (hE : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact)
    (d : AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H LR.pt n) ⟶
      AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H L.pt (n + 1))),
      (∀ x, d.hom x = Abelian.Ext.comp x hE.extClass rfl) ∧
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.H E (n + 1)) ∧
      ∃ beta : ∀ i : I, AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (FR i) n) ⟶
        AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (F i) (n + 1)),
        ∀ i : I,
          beta i ≫ AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op i)) (F i) (n + 1)) ≫
            AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app i) (n + 1)) =
          AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op i)) (FR i) n) ≫
            AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map ((eGR i).inv ≫ LR.ι.app i) n) ≫ d
